us._help: Edit this file when the roster or the hero pools change. 'pool' tiers: primary, secondary, practice. 'avoid' heroes are scored down. 'tier_roles' picks which Icy Veins tier list role applies to the player (Blaze is S as an Offlaner but D as a Tank). Evidence numbers (NGS this season, Storm League) are added by build_playbook.py; do not type records here.
us.high_damage_note: Teams with exactly two real damage dealers (2,400+ hero damage a minute) are 37-23 in Division C West S22.

notes.Sylvanas: 58% over 119 Storm League games in the last year, 62% in the last 6 months, 2 deaths or fewer wins 79%. A structure and camp hero, not a wave clearer.
notes.Junkrat: 56.7% in Storm League but CCS and Cosmos ban it, so do not plan around it.
notes.Hanzo: 45.9% over 268 games, 41% in the last 6 months.
notes.Li-Ming: 41.7% in Storm League. It won Battlefield of Eternity on Oct 6, so it is not banned forever.
notes.Raynor: Only 8 games in the last year. Practice before using.

notes.Tychus: NGS 7-2 this season with 0.7 deaths a game.
notes.Thrall: NGS 3-1, 7-2 in the HealsOnly team games.
notes.Sylvanas: 5-2 in HealsOnly team games but 0-1 in NGS (4 deaths). Only if Hunter is off it.
notes.Tassadar: Lowest deaths on the roster (1.0), a strong Tomb clearer.
notes.Gul'dan: Highest damage (5.4k a minute) but 3.0 deaths.

notes.Blaze: Counted as MELEE in all ranged counts. S tier as an offlaner on most maps (D only as a tank).
notes.Leoric: Counters Anub'arak and Johanna on paper; A tier offlaner on Garden, Dragon Shire and Volskaya.

notes.Muradin: NGS 4-0, 0.8 deaths. But 47.5% career in Storm League, so a small sample.
notes.Johanna: NGS 4-3, 60% recent in Storm League. Valkamer (CCS) is 5-1 on it, so we usually ban it against CCS.
NGS 2-2 with 2.8 deaths. Listed Qhira counter but went 1/6/7 alone in the front on Garden.

notes.Brightwing: NGS 8-4. CCS is 3-6 against Brightwing or Anduin teams and 9-0 against any other healer.

Alterac Pass.name: Alterac Pass
Alterac Pass.notes: - Hunter's best Sylvanas map (9-5). CCS beat us here with 15 deaths. Anchor, camp clearers, objective poke, self sustain.

Battlefield of Eternity.name: Battlefield of Eternity
Battlefield of Eternity.notes: - Early game and camps. We beat Cosmos here in 13 minutes on Oct 6 with Johanna, Brightwing, Li-Ming, Tychus and Blaze. Chen and Sylvanas are S tier.

Dragon Shire.name: Dragon Shire
Dragon Shire.notes: - Needs sustain and a durable shrine holder. CCS beat us here in 26 minutes with 18 of our deaths. Brightwing or Rehgar, Leoric for the shrine, Hanzo is their pick to ban.

Garden of Terror.name: Garden of Terror
Garden of Terror.notes:
- Camp clearers, a double bruiser, Rehgar. Two or fewer ranged heroes (4-1, against 0-3 with three or more).
- We are 3-1 here, all with Rehgar. The loss was to Qhira, Anub'arak, Li-Ming, Tyrande and Ragnaros. Do not leave the tank alone in the front.

Infernal Shrines.name: Infernal Shrines
Infernal Shrines.notes: - CCS is 2-1 and has won both of its own picks here. Ban it. If it comes up: double healer and high wave clear. Three or more ranged heroes is 7-3 on this map.

Sky Temple.name: Sky Temple
Sky Temple.notes:
- Our best map against CCS (we won, they lost on their own pick). Camp clearers, gankers, split push. Sylvanas is 7-4 here in Storm League.
- Chen is S tier here. Ban Ragnaros if CCS shows it.

Tomb of the Spider Queen.name: Tomb of the Spider Queen
Tomb of the Spider Queen.notes:
- Three or more ranged heroes (7-3) and two high clear heroes, one of them ranged. Two or fewer ranged is 2-6.
- Hunter on Chromie or Sylvanas, chelsi on Tassadar, Gul'dan or Tychus. Do not repeat the Oct 6 draft (Sylvanas, Thrall, Leoric, Rehgar, Tyrael, one ranged hero).
- Hunter's Storm League record here is his worst (31-39).

Towers of Doom.name: Towers of Doom
Towers of Doom.notes: - CCS is 4-1 here. We are 0-1. Ban it. If it comes up: gankers, camp clearers, an offlaner who can double soak.

Volskaya Foundry.name: Volskaya Foundry
Volskaya Foundry.notes: - Late game, siege damage and sustain. Hunter's weaker map in Storm League (48%), so Sylvanas, Valla or Orphea and not Hanzo or Li-Ming. We beat CCS here in 18 minutes with two deaths.

Can't Counterpick Stupid.name: Can't Counterpick Stupid
Can't Counterpick Stupid.notes:
## How they win and lose
- Deaths decide it. All four of our losses to them had 15 to 18 of our deaths. When CCS loses, every one of their players dies about twice as often (Valkamer 1.6 to 3.2, WitsEnd 1.2 to 3.2, UnicycleYay 1.6 to 3.2, ultear 1.7 to 3.5).
- Kill ultear (Gold 3) first and make WitsEnd leave Lunara. Do not chase kills on side lanes where ShadowDroid and WitsEnd can catch us.
- ShadowDroid is the clear and camp engine (5.7k minion damage a minute). Deny him Gazlowe.

## Healer pattern
- CCS is 3-6 against teams with Brightwing or Anduin and 9-0 against every other healer. We are 2-1 with Brightwing against them and 0-3 with Rehgar or Stukov. Lock Brightwing early. It has never been banned against us.

## Qhira (UnicycleYay)
- He is 2-3 on Qhira with 4.0 deaths a game and 8-2 on everything else (Sylvanas, Hanzo, Tychus, Valla). Do not spend a round one ban on her. The one time we did, he took Sylvanas and went 7/0/9.
- If she is in the draft, answer with a stun tank, Brightwing, a ranged poker, and kill her in the fights. Cosmos beat her three times that way.

## Draft timing
- They ban Junkrat and Chromie in round one (slots 1 to 4) and Thrall and Tychus in round two (slot 10 or 11). A hero already picked cannot be banned. Lock Thrall or Tychus by slot 9 (first pick) or slot 7 (second pick).
- They have never banned Sylvanas or Brightwing against us.
- Johanna is their favorite first pick (Valkamer 5-1) and counters Tychus and Brightwing. We ban it.

## Coin toss
- They are 9-2 with first pick and 3-4 when they pick the map. When they have first pick against us we are 0-2. Take first pick.

## Their Garden of Terror comp
- Qhira, Anub'arak, Li-Ming, Tyrande and Ragnaros beat us on fights (5.0k against 3.5k fight damage a minute) and experience (3.33k against 2.69k). Ban Ragnaros. Chen and Stukov answer Ragnaros, Leoric or Varian answer Anub'arak.

rules._help: Judgment calls live here, each with a reason and where the evidence is. Edit, add or delete rules freely, then run build_playbook.py. scope: opp (team name or *), map (map name or *), side (first, second or *). kinds: pick_bonus {heroes}, ban_bonus {heroes}, ban_discount {heroes: multiplier below 1}, ranged_target {min and or max}, min_marksmen {n}, note {text}.

rules.why: Teams with two or more marksmen are 13-6 in Division C West S22. Facing two or more with one or none of our own is 5-12.
Tomb: 7-3 with three or more ranged heroes (Blaze not counted) and 2-6 with two or fewer. Icy Veins wants poke for the objective and high wave clear.
Garden: 4-1 with two or fewer ranged heroes and 0-3 with three or more. Camp clearers, double bruiser, Rehgar.
Shrines: 7-3 with three or more ranged heroes and 4-8 with two or fewer. A lean from 11 games. Icy Veins wants a double healer and high wave clear.
CCS is 3-6 against Brightwing or Anduin teams and 9-0 against every other healer. We are 2-1 with Brightwing against them and 0-3 with Rehgar or Stukov.
Johanna is their favorite first pick (4 times, Valkamer 5-1) and counters our Tychus and Brightwing. Lunara is WitsEnd's 8-3 hero and a second marksman.
UnicycleYay is 2-3 on Qhira (4.0 deaths a game) and 8-2 on everything else. Banning her sends him to Sylvanas, Hanzo or Tychus.
Ragnaros had 265k minion damage and 34k experience in the Garden loss. Chen and Stukov are our answers if it is open.
UnicycleYay Hanzo was in their Dragon Shire win over us.
UnicycleYay's highest damage hero (4.1k a minute).
ShadowDroid's clear and carry hero (3-1 for CCS).

rules.text: CCS bans Thrall and Tychus in round two (slot 10 or 11). Lock them by slot 9 (first pick) or slot 7 (second pick). They have never banned Sylvanas or Brightwing against us.
rules.why: Thrall banned in 5 of 6 games against us, Tychus in 2 of 6.
In Season 22 NGS: SilverJackal is 8-2 on Kael'thas, Nae 6-1 on Anub'arak, Imbuement 6-0 on Greymane.
Cosmos is 4-0 with Johanna. Taking it is a denial. Cosmos struggles into Muradin and Stitches comps.
